description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlement entity in the OrangeHRM project. It tests the behavior of LeaveEntitlement objects, including setting and retrieving entitlement days. The class includes setup, data providers, and test methods, and interacts with other entity classes such as Employee and LeaveType.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the functionality of the LeaveEntitlement entity, including setting days, date ranges, and associations with Employee and LeaveType entities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by truncating leave entitlement tables before each test.

methods.name: testLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Tests the setting and getting of leave entitlement days, as well as the default days used.

methods.name: leaveEntitlementDataProvider
methods.description: Provides different test data for leave entitlement days, including decimal values and string representations.
